items.name: Hold Breath
entries: The hippopotamus can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

items.name: Trampling Charge
entries: If the hippopotamus moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a bite attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. If the target is {@condition prone}, the hippopotamus can make one stomp attack against it as a bonus action.

items.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) piercing damage.
